meta.title: Message Edit / Retry
meta.description: Adds "Edit" and "Retry" next to the copy button on every user message. Edit resends your rewritten text, Retry resends the original; both fork a new branch from just before that turn and send the message from there — dsh session logs are append-only, so rewriting history in place would leave the UI and the model looking at different content, so this follows the built-in branch button instead. The original session is kept exactly as it was, and the parent/child link shows up in the sidebar.
